messages:
Mina: Quick quarterly handoff: recurrence analysis shows 3 persistent vectors — scale-down races, cache eviction cascades, and noisy model rollouts. Need owners + short remediation tasks we can push to the recurrence board.

Omar: Can we prioritize by customer-facing impact? I can pull a small table but short answer: scale-down races hit high-traffic services most.

Selena: I dug into 8 recurrences over last 10 weeks: 4 scale-down, 3 cache, 1 model. Median MTTRs: scale-down 20m, cache 25m, model 40m.

Priya: OK. Let's create one-line action items here (format: owner | action | ETA) so I can import them. Also add a one-line playbook snippet for oncall.

Omar: "Omar | bump graceful window 30->90s for warm pools + backup gating | 2026-04-05"

Selena: "Selena | enable prefix-hot-cache + ingress batch cap flag | 2026-04-12"

Mina: "Mina | add tokenization/compat preflight to model swap pipeline | 2026-04-18"

Priya: Oncall playbook snippets (3 steps each):
- scale-down race: 1) increase graceful window, 2) disable aggressive downscale, 3) move traffic to warm pool
- cache eviction: 1) set cache readonly, 2) enable hot-prefix flag, 3) scale cache nodes
- model rollback: 1) revert to previous model, 2) run tokenization check, 3) block further swaps

ops-bot: ticket created: #INC-2026-1401 "Recurrence: scale-down & cache handoff" (linked)

Selena: I'll add monitoring dashboards (cache hit ratio, 502 rate) and low-threshold alerts.

Omar: I'll open infra PR for graceful-window toggle and add canary steps. Canary plan: one region 24h -> global. Rollback if pod churn not reduced.

Mina: I'll implement preflight tests and add a checksum gate. Block swap if token mismatch >0.2%.

Priya: Thanks. Final ask: owners confirm with :white_check_mark: so I can mark imported. Follow-up sync scheduled in 7 days to review canaries.

Omar: :white_check_mark:

Selena: :white_check_mark:

Mina: :white_check_mark:

Priya: Closing and importing now. Will post summary to #incidents-all for transparency.
